snippet.title: Just Dance 3 Target Edition - Song List + Extras [PS3]
snippet.description:
Hi! As promised, today I bring you the Song List of the Target Exclusive Edition of Just Dance 3 for the PlayStation 3! Featuring songs that are not in other editions of JD 3 like Airplanes by B.o.B and Only Girl (In The World) by Rihanna! Enjoy!

Don't forget to share, comment, like and subscribe! Thank you!
